input.oldString:
echo "Proprietary Software Scanner for Linux"
echo "======================================"
echo "Scanning installed packages for potentially proprietary software..."
echo ""

# Function to check if a package is from official repos
is_official_repo() {
    local repo="$1"
    case "$repo" in
        core|extra|community|multilib|cachyos*)
            return 0  # true
            ;;
        *)
            return 1  # false
            ;;
    esac
}

# Get list of installed packages
packages=$(pacman -Q | awk '{print $1}')

total_packages=$(echo "$packages" | wc -l)
echo "Total installed packages: $total_packages"
echo ""

proprietary_count=0

for pkg in $packages; do
    # Get repository info
    repo_info=$(pacman -Qi "$pkg" 2>/dev/null | grep "Installed From" | awk '{print $4}')
    
    if [[ -z "$repo_info" ]]; then
        repo_info="AUR/Unknown"
    fi
    
    if ! is_official_repo "$repo_info"; then
        echo "$pkg (Repository: $repo_info) - Potentially proprietary"
        ((proprietary_count++))
    fi
done

echo ""
echo "Scan complete."
echo "Potentially proprietary packages found: $proprietary_count"
echo ""
echo "Note: This tool flags packages not from official Arch/CachyOS repositories."
echo "Some AUR packages may still be free software. Check licenses manually for accuracy."
input.newString:
echo "Proprietary Software Scanner for Linux"
echo "======================================"
echo "Scanning installed packages for potentially proprietary software..."
echo ""

# Get list of foreign packages (not from official repos)
foreign_packages=$(pacman -Q --foreign | awk '{print $1}')

total_packages=$(pacman -Q | wc -l)
foreign_count=$(echo "$foreign_packages" | wc -l)
echo "Total installed packages: $total_packages"
echo "Packages from unofficial sources: $foreign_count"
echo ""

if [[ $foreign_count -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "Potentially proprietary packages (from AUR or other sources):"
    echo ""
    for pkg in $foreign_packages; do
        echo "- $pkg"
    done
else
    echo "No packages from unofficial sources found."
fi

echo ""
echo "Scan complete."
echo ""
echo "Note: This tool flags packages not from official repositories."
echo "Unofficial packages may include proprietary software. Check licenses manually for accuracy."
